messages:
alina: Quick heads up 14E2 planning to cut release 2026.05.0 tomorrow 09:30 PST. Main change: adaptive batching + small kernel tweak. Drafting internal release note and need rollback/pin guidance. @brandon @sean can you eyeball?

brandon: skimmed the diff. Looks fine but adaptive batcher can mis-size under sudden spikes. Recommend pin runtime to v2.5.3 for 24h and conservative canary gates.

sean: +1 for pin v2.5.3. Canary plan suggestion: 4% for 10m -> 20% for 20m -> 60% for 30m -> 100%. Abort conditions: P95 token latency >700ms OR 5xx >0.5% sustained 5m OR KV cache mismatch from deploybot.

alina: OK can we turn that into the one-paragraph internal blurb (embargoed) and a TL;DR for oncall? Need it by 09:10 PST to schedule the embargoed post.

brandon: Draft blurb below, copy if useful:
"""
Internal (embargo until 09:20 PST): Release 2026.05.0 rolling 09:30 PST. Includes adaptive batching improvements and a micro-optimization to the small-context serving kernel. Canary will be progressive (4% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%) with runtime pinned to v2.5.3 for 24 hours. Oncall: sean (primary), brandon (secondary). Abort and rollback if P95 token latency >700ms or 5xx >0.5% for 5m. If you see KV cache or shard errors, escalate to infra.
"""
Please mark embargo until 09:20 PST.

deploybot: Scheduled job created: `/deploy release/2026.05.0 --canary 4,20,60 --pin runtime:v2.5.3 --notify #eng-releases` (embargo-until=8493008400)

oncall-bot: oncall rotation set: sean (primary), brandon (secondary). Pager thresholds set: token-p95=700ms, 5xx=0.5%

alina: Thanks 44D I'll paste the blurb into the internal announce at 09:10 and schedule deploybot for 09:30. Final checklist I'm saving in the release doc: 1) embargoed blurb posted at 09:10, 2) deploybot scheduled, 3) canary gate checks and dashboards verified, 4) rollback contacts + playbook linked, 5) post-release evals ready.

brandon: I'll monitor the canary dashboards and post quick notes here at each gate.

sean: will standby. If we need to abort prefer rollback to runtime:v2.5.1 and hold full traffic until we run the regression test set.

alina: Great 680 locking this in. Pinning the release doc in #eng-releases after posting the embargoed blurb.
